deployments_detail.use: AI real-time interpretation/translation service supporting 38 languages for foreign customers, using STT + machine translation + TTS. Staff use PDAs, customers use their phones. Industry-first for a Korean convenience store; deployed in 5 directly-operated stores. [Flitto]

CU Mode: in-store voice-guidance accessibility feature for visually impaired shoppers, giving real-time spoken product names, prices, shelf locations and promotions. Built into the Sullivan Plus AI visual-assistance app. [Two Art (Tuat) / Sullivan Plus]
CU Customer Center chatbot: AI customer-service chatbot answering 200+ FAQ (membership, events, store locations) for quick self-service handling. [BGF Retail (chatbot)]

ASK (AI Shared Knowledge): in-house RAG-based enterprise knowledge search platform on internal groupware, letting employees query company bulletin boards, documents, HR rules and attachments (Hangul, PPT, Excel) in natural language. Built with Hancom, on-premise. [Hancom]
UiPath RPA plus AI Document Understanding (DU) for automating back-office document processing. UiPath first deployed in 2022, DU added in 2024. [UiPath]

Physical-AI logistics humanoid robot ('AI Worker') for distribution-center work: BGF Logis (CU's logistics subsidiary) partners with robotics firm Robotis to jointly develop and pilot humanoids for non-standard logistics tasks in CU distribution centers. [Robotis (BGF Logis)]
AI synthetic-consumer prediction + digital-twin store simulation "ParaStore" (Intellisia MOU, Jul 2026) for product/pricing/promo testing

CU Smart Ordering 2.0: AI deep-learning auto-replenishment system that computes optimal order quantities per store SKU using variables like day-of-week, season, and promotions. Rolled out to franchise stores from April 2023. [BGF Retail in-house (AI deep learning)]
deployments_detail.value: Stockouts reduced 20.8%, sales up 4.8% in pilot

deployments_detail.use: Deeping Source 'Plus Insight' AI video analytics in CU smart stores to track customer movement and interest in products, and detect operational issues (e.g. dirty tasting tables). MOU/introduction announced. [Deeping Source]

AI Makeup Palette Maker: in-store kiosk where a customer's face is photographed and AI diagnoses personal color / skin tone, recommends matching colors, and produces a custom makeup palette. First cosmetics-manufacturing service in Korean convenience stores. [Prinker Korea]

'Today's CU Pick' (오늘의 CU픽): convenience-store-industry-first AI chatbot recommending products, trained on CU new-product/category data plus real customer-reaction data (blog reviews, SNS photos) to give personalized food/product recommendations. [BGF Retail (AI chatbot)]

AI synthetic consumers / digital twins for product planning: partnership with startup Intellisia to generate large-scale virtual consumers to predict new-product reactions and simulate store merchandising/display. MOU signed; PoC on lunchboxes ran from May 2026. [Intellisia]
